go.description: True only where the plan can be built as it stands.

findings.description: Each thing that keeps the plan from being built as it stands, with what you checked. Empty where go is true.

checked.description: What you verified against the code or the request, so a reader knows what the verdict stands on; and, each starting not checked:, what you could not verify and why.

closure.description: What the closure part of the audit found, one entry for each class it checked: the sites it searched out itself that the plan's site list lacks, and the cells of the universe, per the repository's closure text, that the plan's universe leaves out without a reason. Empty where it found none - and a site the plan missed, an axis left out without a reason, an item that patches one site of several, and an item that changes a decision and declares no class are findings, which hold go back.

class.description: The class, by the id the plan names it by.

missingSites.description: Each site the audit found that the plan's site list lacks, named by its path and its symbol.

missingCells.description: Each axis or cell of the universe, per the repository's closure text, that the plan's universe leaves out without a reason.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
